full_prompt_en: A square fantasy anime illustration shows two very young explorers crouched together in thick grass beneath a deep blue twilight sky. The background is almost entirely atmospheric, moving from navy at the top into a misty cyan glow behind the figures. Slanting shafts of light enter from the upper right, and a few long blurred blades of grass cut across the left edge. The child on the left has dark tousled hair and wears a reddish helmet with round goggles fixed across the top. Their wide pale blue eyes look upward and slightly left, while the small open mouth suggests surprise. A dark layered jacket, gloves, and travel straps cover the body, most of which disappears below the grass. On the right, a fair-haired child is slightly taller in the frame. Large metal-rimmed goggles sit over a soft fur-edged cap, with pale strands hanging beside the face. Big blue eyes stare in the same direction, and the round open mouth echoes the first child's reaction. A thick scarf wraps the neck above a brown coat. The two heads sit close together in the upper middle, their brightly lit faces standing out against the cool shadows. The lower half is packed with tall green blades, some sharp and some soft from depth of field. A small yellow-green glow shines among the grass near the bottom center, lighting a few nearby stems from below. Diffuse light from the upper right lifts hair, goggles, and cheeks, while the surrounding blue atmosphere remains dark. No readable text appears. The overall composition is intimate but mysterious, using oversized expressive eyes, layered grass, and a tiny warm light within cool twilight to suggest an unseen discovery.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻动漫插画呈现两位年幼探险者并肩蹲在浓密草丛里，头顶是深蓝暮光天空。后景几乎全由空气感构成，从顶部海军蓝过渡到人物身后雾状的青蓝微光。斜向光束从右上方进入，几根失焦的长草叶划过左边缘。左侧孩子有蓬乱深发，戴一顶红色头盔，圆形护目镜固定在顶部。宽大的浅蓝眼睛向左上望去，小小张开的嘴表现惊讶。深色层叠外套、手套和旅行背带包住身体，大部分身体没入草丛。右侧的浅发孩子在画中略高，柔软带毛边的帽子上架着大号金属圈护目镜，浅色发丝垂在脸旁。大蓝眼睛望向同一方向，圆圆张开的嘴呼应第一个孩子的反应。厚围巾裹住脖子，下方是棕色外套。两颗头紧贴在中上部，受光明亮的面孔从冷色阴影中浮现。画面下半部塞满高草，有些锋利清楚，有些因景深而柔软。下部中央附近一小团黄绿色光在草间发亮，从下方照亮几根相邻草茎。右上漫射光提亮头发、护目镜和脸颊，周围蓝色空气仍保持深暗。没有可读文字。整体构图亲密却神秘，用夸张且富表情的大眼睛、层叠草丛与冷暮光中的一点暖光暗示尚未显露的发现。
style_prompt_en: The fantasy anime treatment combines small rounded expressive forms with intricate layered surroundings and cinematic atmospheric color. Clear, dark contours define focal features, while peripheral edges soften into haze and shallow focus. Deep navy and teal dominate; pale cyan light describes volume, and a tiny yellow-green accent supplies a secondary center of attention. Fine strands, soft fabric texture, and clustered organic strokes bring tactile variety without overwhelming the simple focal shapes. Light falls diagonally through the scene, touching upper edges and cheeks before dispersing into cool shadow. Foreground blur partly veils the bottom, and overlapping middle layers make the shallow space feel immersive. Smooth color transitions in the atmosphere contrast with sharper ink-like accents near the eyes and reflective rims. The overall effect is curious, tender, and slightly ominous, with selective illumination guiding the gaze through dense detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这种奇幻动漫处理把小巧圆润、富表情的形体与繁复层叠的环境及电影化空气色彩结合。清楚的深色轮廓界定焦点特征，周边边缘则柔化进雾气和浅景深。深海军蓝与青绿占主导，浅青光描述体积，一小处黄绿色重音提供次级注意力中心。细丝、柔软布料肌理和成簇的有机笔触带来可触的变化，却不淹没简洁焦点形状。光斜穿场景，掠过上缘和受光面后散入冷影。前景虚化部分遮住下方，重叠的中间层让浅空间显得沉浸。空气中的平滑色彩过渡对照焦点附近较锐利的墨线重音和反光边圈。整体效果好奇、温柔且略带不安，选择性照明引导视线穿过密集细节。
theme_en: Two young explorers peering through grass beneath a blue twilight sky
theme_zh: 两位年幼探险者在蓝色暮光下透过草丛张望
name: Made in Abyss
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
